term: available reasons, enhanced justification, generated warrant and adequate explanation
resolution: Klein–Turri availability is not actual infinite traversal. A reason not yet reason-enhanced need not be wholly unjustified. Their scoped enhancement/reflective-knowledge arguments do not address every epistemic status and assume non-skepticism in the stated context. GeneratedWarrant remains the separately stipulated all-premise inductive standard; its emptiness is not a refutation of every infinitist or holistic norm. A reason-support edge is neither actual warrant nor an actual causal/explanatory relation; no temporal, ontological or causal conclusion transfers without an independently defended mapping and norm.
